snippet.description:
A major problem among UPSC Mains aspirants is that they keep studying but don’t write enough answers or tests. In fact, only around 20% of students preparing for Mains are writing tests.

In this video, understand why answer writing and test practice cannot be postponed until after Prelims. The goal should be to complete your UPSC Mains preparation by December, so that June–July can be focused on revision, updating current affairs, and extensive answer writing.

If you’re preparing for UPSC CSE 2027, don’t make the mistake of spending all your time studying without practising what you’ve learned.
